decision: Reject native_record_batch v1; no validation; same full Goal remains incomplete.
facts: Four preregistered original-benchmark cells evaluated; 20 first-valid official judge slots retained. Four product reviews committed e47c8d3 before aggregate scores, individual scores or method mapping were read. Same coordinator, not independent human review; behavior can identify a method.

Changed task 283 Late: SP and candidate each 0/1 completed and 0/1 core pass, TF 9.0 each; PE 8.6 versus 9.2. SP saved 47 tasks and no final answer; candidate saved 29 tasks and an unfinished 54-character sentence. All persisted IDs and references checked; no numeric difficulty lowering or requirement deletion observed.

SP stopped at 12 rounds with tool_calls. Candidate stopped at round 10 with length; final completion used 4096 tokens, including 4083 reasoning tokens. These metadata establish budget termination, not why the model allocated its work that way.
Both arms called parse_prd zero times. Candidate used 29 create_task plus 22 update_task; SP 47 plus 20. Total tool calls 56 versus 70. Thus native fanout was not exercised by either actor.

Retention 235 Late: both completed with TF/PE 10.0. Core pass candidate 1/1 versus SP 0/1; source values preserved in both, SP calls the August decline a plateau. Both received byte-identical K0, so this outcome difference cannot be attributed to changed tool knowledge.

Twelve frozen task-free native calls established limited parser preservation, explicit ID linking, invalid-grammar fallback, long-paragraph truncation and duplicate creation. These are contract checks, not successful benchmark artifacts.

196 raw/archive members including dedicated ledger, stdout, native stderr, probe workspace and 12 pinned native source files, plus 358 execution-source files passed offline hash and metric verification. No retry until success, no validation, no new updater model call.
observations_not_causal_claims: Fewer calls/tasks, one earlier complexity analysis and slightly higher PE did not yield final delivery. With one run per arm and no parser use, none is attributable to the intended batch-write mediator.

Candidate last prompt 63698 tokens exceeds SP last prompt 56588 despite fewer calls; candidate called list_tasks and analyze_task_complexity. Raw output accumulation is compatible with budget pressure but is not an isolated intervention or demonstrated root cause.

Prior withdrawal runs first used the analyzer at round 10/11, once each. This falsifies the specific narrative of repeated analysis looping in those runs, not every form of over-expansion or refinement.
unknowns: Whether the actor rejected the parser for its limited fields/flat output, failed to use the knowledge, or preferred the create_task recommendation in native responses. We did not read hidden reasoning or intervene on these explanations.
Whether correct native batch adoption would reduce total reasoning or dependency edits sufficiently to improve completion and quality.
The relative contribution of per-record construction, task planning, observation size and final reasoning allocation to truncation.

sensitivity.235_summary: If small plateau is accepted as loose language, SP235 core becomes pass; the primary 283 strict dual gate still fails. B03 hedged holiday speculation receives no causal credit, consistently for both arms. No post-unblinding review changes.
sensitivity.283_artifact: A plan-only reading could credit both saved structures, but frozen delivery_truth is required. Even relaxing it cannot create a normal completion gain; final delivery and completion remain separate metrics.

next_decision.do_not_repeat: Do not rerun this exact candidate, tune phrasing, force parse_prd in the actor, add a batch executor, change budgets, or declare native batch methods ineffective.
next_decision.valuable_discriminator: Before another model experiment, establish a distinct knowledge representation or dependency/selection mechanism that can test route adoption versus parser suitability using task-free source/native evidence. Revisit actual input-domain requirements and conflicting route information; an additional imperative sentence would repeat the failed version.
next_decision.admission: No next candidate is yet frozen or admitted. Existing code/source evidence can be examined within current authorization; lack of a winner is not a new permission or successful-positive prerequisite.
next_decision.out_of_scope: An added bulk API/macro executor or state-dependent tool forcing changes native/actor conditions; not executed and not a blocker for legal knowledge adaptations.
